annotations.title: Sync lead-form leads to a Klaviyo list

description: Put the leads the brand's LEAD FORMS collected (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, X Ads, Snapchat, ChatGPT Ads) into a Klaviyo LIST: each lead with an email becomes a Klaviyo profile (name and the form it came from) and joins listId. Nobody is SUBSCRIBED to marketing: a lead form is not consent Hermoso can vouch for, so their consent status is unchanged. Synced leads are remembered per list, so a re-run never repeats a write. since (default 7 days ago), platforms narrows it, dryRun:true lists what would be synced. Needs profiles:write and lists:write on the key. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: sync_leads_to_klaviyo
title: Sync lead-form leads to a Klaviyo list
